description: Stop the moving reticle on the bullseye to win GAS, with a provably fair TEE-generated target pattern. Pick a target lane, pay a small GAS entry, tap to lock each shot as the target sweeps a gauge, and land enough accuracy hits before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Warm-up Lane (3 hits), 0.5 for Arcade Range (5 hits), 1 for Pro Circuit (7 hits). Every tap is recorded in a Morpheus TEE session and replayed to make the score unforgeable. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 在瞄准刻度上停住移动的靶心即可赢取 GAS，靶心模式由 TEE 保证可验证公平。选择瞄准靶道并支付少量 GAS 报名费，靶心在刻度尺上移动时点击锁定每一发，在截止时间前达到足够的精准命中数即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：热身靶道 0.1（命中 3 次）、街机靶场 0.5（5 次）、职业赛场 1（7 次）。每次点击都记录在 Morpheus TEE 会话中并回放，使分数不可伪造。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The target pattern is generated inside a Morpheus TEE enclave from a deterministic per-game secret, with only its hash commitment bound on-chain at the start. The enclave replays the recorded taps, applies a behavioural timing gate (no super-human bursts), and signs the accuracy hits reached after checking the commitment.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
